description: 70 development turns in ten seven-turn conversations; correlated repeated source families, not70independent questions. This is a continuity and boundary suite.

questions: For a new NYC apartment under the 2022 Building Code, what is the ordinary minimum living-room ceiling height, with no exception?
What if the space is the bathroom instead?
Now consider an occupiable office space, not a habitable dwelling room. What minimum applies?
Back to the apartment living room: would 7 feet 6 inches be enough without an exception?
And an ordinary laundry room?
Does that bathroom dimension start at the structural slab or finished floor?
If its finished floor is raised 2 inches while the ceiling remains fixed at 7 feet above the old finished floor, does it still satisfy the ordinary bathroom minimum?
checks: Finished floor; to finished underside of ceiling or beams.

questions: Under 2022 NYC plumbing rules, what is the minimum fall for 60 feet of 4-inch horizontal sanitary drainage pipe?
Keep the 60-foot length, but change the pipe to 2 inches. What fall?
Now make that pipe 8 inches; same length.
What if it is 6-inch pipe instead?
Keep the 6-inch pipe but shorten the run to 20 feet.
Would a level run with zero fall meet that slope requirement?
Does the required slope have to be uniform along the run?
checks: Yes; uniform alignment and uniform slope.

questions: For an ordinary non-accessible NYC toilet compartment, is 14 inches from WC centerline to sidewall sufficient under 2022 PC?
If I increase it to 15 inches, does that satisfy this one dimension?
For adjacent fixtures in this ordinary layout, can their centers be 28 inches apart?
Can the clear space in front of the toilet be 20 inches to a wall?
Is a floor-mounted water-closet compartment 58 inches deep enough under the ordinary rule?
Change to a wall-hung WC compartment 56 inches deep. Does it meet just that depth requirement?
Can that compartment be 29 inches wide?
checks: Yes side dimension only, not whole compliance.

questions: Under 2022 NYC MC, what minimum condensate drain diameter is required for a manifold serving 30 tons?
Change total capacity to exactly 20 tons.
Now exactly 40 tons.
Now 41 tons.
Now 100 tons.
Now 200 tons.
For that 200-ton manifold, can I reduce the drain downstream to 3/4 inch because that is the general minimum?
checks: No;2inches sizing and no downstream reduction.

questions: Under 2022 NYC MC, can an attic HVAC passage be 40 feet long if clear 6 feet high and 24 inches wide throughout? Address only this length exception.
Would 51 feet qualify under that same exception?
Return to 40 feet long but reduce clear height to 5 feet. Does that length exception still work?
Under the ordinary attic access rule, what minimum clear access-opening dimensions apply?
What minimum solid-flooring width does the ordinary passageway require?
Can I keep a 20-by 30-inch access opening if the largest appliance cannot fit through it?
What ordinary level service-space size is needed at sides requiring access?
checks: 20by30inches and enough to remove largest appliance.
No;must also allow largest appliance removal.

questions: For an ordinary NYC gas appliance under 2022 FGC, can its shutoff be 8 feet away in the same room? No exception applies.
If it is exactly 6 feet away, does that satisfy the distance alone?
What if it is 4 feet away but in a different room?
Back in the same room, can an ordinary valve be 62 inches above finished floor when the gas connection is 40 inches above floor?
Now the appliance gas connection is 72 inches above floor. Does the code include an exception to that valve-height limit?
Should the shutoff be upstream or downstream of the connector it serves?
May it be inaccessible behind permanent construction?
checks: No;60inch limit and height exception notestablished.

questions: Under 2022 NYC FGC, how deep must ordinary buried gas piping be without special plate protection, and where is depth measured?
If a 4-inch-outside-diameter pipe centerline is 24 inches below grade, does it meet that requirement?
What minimum steel-plate thickness is specified by the reduced-depth exception?
Would a 1/8-inch-thick plate satisfy that specified thickness?
How far below the plate must the pipe be, at minimum?
If no plate is used, may the pipe top be 18 inches below grade under this rule?
If the top is exactly 24 inches below grade with no plate, does it meet this depth requirement alone?
Under 2022 NYC Fire Code, what clearance must ordinary storage maintain below sprinkler head deflectors, with no special authorization?
What clearance instead applies below the ceiling in a nonsprinklered area?
Return to sprinklered storage. Deflectors are 2 inches below the ceiling and storage is 20 inches below ceiling. Is the required deflector clearance met?
Same deflectors but storage is 18 inches below ceiling. Is that enough?
May cardboard boxes be stored in the mechanical equipment room?
Does placing noncombustible storage within 30 inches of a fire partition automatically allow storage to the ceiling?
May storage obstruct the means of egress if it meets the vertical clearance?
Under ZR 25-811, how many enclosed bike spaces for one ordinary residential building with 11 dwelling units? No automobile parking or other waiver.
Reduce the building to exactly 10 dwelling units. Does the small-building waiver apply?
Change it to 12 dwelling units.
Change it to 13 dwelling units.
Instead, there are two separate buildings of 6 dwelling units each. Are they simply combined to exceed the ten-unit waiver?
Now consider one building of 33 rooming units, no automobile parking or other waiver. How many spaces?
For that 33-rooming-unit building, can I round 5.5 spaces down to 5?
Under ZR 25-83, what is the default area per enclosed bicycle parking space before any certified reduction?
Could I use 8 squarefeet per space without Commissioner certification?
What is the lowest area if the maximum 9-square-foot reduction is certified?
Could that same maximum reduction yield 5 squarefeet per space?
What is the ordinary same-lot location rule before invoking an off-site exception?
Under ZR 25-84, would an ordinary off-site room 900 feet from the nearest boundary of the served lot meet the distance criterion alone?
What if that distance is 1100 feet and there is no shared subsurface facility?
